final: WITH g AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio_avg FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) AS overall_avg FROM g WHERE ratio_avg IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT g.invoice_number, g.avg_cost, g.ratio_avg, g.ratio_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.ratio_avg > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_cost) AS avg_of_avg_cost, AVG(ratio_avg) AS avg_of_ratio_avg, AVG(diff) AS avg_of_diff FROM k
